name: Airplanes.live
description: Live ADS-B aircraft positions by hex, callsign, registration, type, squawk, military/privacy category, or geographic radius. The public REST API is non-commercial, limited to 500 requests/day and one request/second, and has no SLA.

tools.name: get_aircraft_by_hex
tools.description: Get live state for aircraft matching one or more Mode-S/ICAO hex identifiers.

hex.description: One identifier or comma-separated identifiers, up to 1000.

tools.name: get_aircraft_by_callsign
tools.description: Get live aircraft matching one or more exact callsigns.

callsign.description: One callsign or a comma-separated set.

tools.name: get_aircraft_by_registration
tools.description: Get live aircraft matching one or more registrations/tail numbers.

tools.name: get_aircraft_by_type
tools.description: Get live aircraft matching an ICAO aircraft type code such as A321 or B738.

tools.name: get_aircraft_by_squawk
tools.description: Get live aircraft broadcasting an exact four-digit octal squawk.

tools.name: aircraft_near_point
tools.description: List live aircraft within a radius of a point. Radius is in nautical miles and cannot exceed 250.

tools.name: list_military_aircraft
tools.description: List live aircraft tagged as military.

tools.name: list_ladd_aircraft
tools.description: List live aircraft tagged under Limiting Aircraft Data Displayed (LADD).

tools.name: list_pia_aircraft
tools.description: List live aircraft using Privacy ICAO Address identifiers.
